messages:
sam: Quick heads-up 1 — AcmeCorp pilot kickoff tomorrow. We need the preflight gate + onboarding checklist to avoid last-minute network surprises.

jin: got it. i pushed a draft preflight JSON output that the installer should emit on success/fail. will paste below.

sam: paste please.

jin: ```
{
  "preflight_status": "PASS",
  "checks": ["outbound_connectivity", "dns_resolve", "kms_reachable", "time_sync"],
  "notes": "proxy detected; agent will use HTTP proxy."
}
```

tara: perfect. add a short human-readable summary too so SEs can skim: e.g., "Outbound OK, DNS OK, KMS unreachable".

marco: question on rollout: are we expecting customers to schedule a maintenance window? acme asked for zero-downtime but also wants to avoid any agent restart.

sam: our plan: for initial pilots we require a 30m window for major migrations. for routine patches we can attempt hot swap. need side-by-side agent support to meet zero-downtime if they pin models.

jin: side-by-side prototype is working on my branch. agent can run as agent-v1 and agent-v2 with shared socket mux. caveat: need token leasing to prevent double-execution.

marco: token leasing = important. we've seen duplicate bill events in past. add idempotency id to runtime requests.

ops-bot: ops-bot: note 1 - staging does not have an AWS/GCP cross-account peering simulator. file infra#1288 to track.

tara: mitigation: provide terraform snippets for typical VPC peering, plus an outbound-only option (wss) for customers who forbid inbound. include example for Azure Private Link.

sam: legal: we need borderline SLA language for pilot. can legal review the draft credit formula: if upgrade causes >5m of total downtime for tenant, credit = 10% of monthly seat fee pro-rated?

legal: happy to review. prefer a sliding scale: 5-30m -> 10%, 30-120m -> 25%, >120m -> 50%. we also want explicit exclusions for customer-managed network.

jin: noted. i'll add a "network-excluded" clause to the installer preflight. preflight will return EXCLUDED_NETWORK if DNS or outbound fails.

marco: telemetry ask: we need per-tenant heartbeat metrics and a time-series flag to show RTO during upgrades. that'll drive SLA calculations. can platform team expose a per-tenant recent_heartbeat metric?

ops-bot: ops-bot: metric export requested. open ticket telem#442.

sam: fallback strategy: propose two-tier fallback: (1) soft-fallback via managed edge for short blips (<2m), (2) hard-fallback to edge for >2m and manual review. Offer as paid option.

tara: document wise: call feature "Managed-edge fallback (opt-in)" and include cost multiplier and feature limitations (no local network access, limited throughput).

marco: tests: add simulated NAT timeouts, proxy auth failures, and MTU path-discovery failures. include a test that flips customer DNS responses mid-session.

jin: will add tests to staging harness. estimate 2 sprints to finish all tests and preflight UX.

sam: customer acceptance template (CAT): include network checklist, preflight JSON, upgrade roll-forward/rollback steps, and an observability runbook. SEs should run CAT with pilot.

legal: also require a data-handling appendix for on-prem data plane: keys never leave customer KMS, and audit logs stored for 90 days by default.

marco: deployment ops: add a human-in-the-loop switch for initial pilots so we don't auto-fallback to edge without SE approval.

jin: added flag in agent: allow_auto_edge: false by default for pilot-tenants.

ops-bot: ops-bot: reminder - onboarding call scheduled: private-deploy-onboard-acmecorp at 1774450000.

sam: action items: jin -> finalize preflight JSON + implement EXCLUDED_NETWORK code (due 1774520000); tara -> draft terraform snippets + CAT (due 1774590000); marco -> metrics + ops knobs (due 1774660000); legal -> SLA sliding-scale + appendix (due 1774720000).

marco: ok. i'll also reach out to SE to get Acme's network contact for a pre-kickoff network call.

sam: thanks all. keep messages short in the pilot channel. we'll iterate after first CAT run. :white_check_mark:
